Accessibility

Finding your next service should be straightforward. This website supports keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, mobile layouts and reduced-motion settings.

Images and colour

Editorial images begin in black and white. Hover, tap or use the keyboard controls to reveal colour. Service names, prices and descriptions are available as text; you do not need to see the photographs to choose a service.

Music is optional

The soundtrack is off by default and only loads when you open its panel. Use the close button or Escape to close the panel.

Help with your visit

For physical access requirements or help arranging a visit, contact Lions through Instagram or Facebook, or ask at 2 Mint Walk, Croydon, CR0 1EA.

If something on the website is difficult to use, tell the shop which page and what you were trying to do. We welcome feedback. This statement does not claim a formal accessibility audit.
